# Marina New York City

> Cinematic New York City stories, events, guides, photography, and creator work by Marina Kapler (@marina.newyorkcity).

Marina Kapler is a New York City content creator, photographer, and visual storyteller specializing in cinematic iPhone videography, brand storytelling, event coverage, and licensed NYC footage. She holds an official NYC MOME press pass.

## Right Now (November 2026)

- Top events this week (November 2 to 8, 2026): Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrival (Nov 7), Candy Land NYC (opening November), Bank of America Winter Village at Bryant Park, The Rink at Rockefeller Center (90th anniversary season), Canstruction at Brookfield Place (Oct 30 to Nov 9), Macy's Holiday Square, Gingerbread NYC: The Great Borough Bake-Off, Rockefeller Center Holiday Chalets, Central Park Fall Foliage, Times Square Midnight Moment.
- Latest stories: NYSE Announces 103rd Annual Christmas Tree Lighting (Dec 3, 2026), 53rd Village Halloween Parade Takes Over Sixth Avenue, Candlelight Halloween Concert Lights Up the Vessel, Rockefeller Center Reveals Its 2026 Christmas Tree.
